title: Fixture: Choosing a Listing Photo
content:
This article does not exist. It is a build fixture, used only by a verification build that has no database, so the SEO checks can see a blog at all. See scripts/data/README.md.

This one carries a featured_image_url on a host this repository does not control, which is the case where og:image width and height must NOT be asserted — the code has never seen that file (US-174).

Keeping it in the fixture means that path runs on every verification build rather than being something somebody once checked by hand and then stopped checking.
excerpt: A build fixture, not an article. It exists so a database-less verification build still renders the blog.
seo_description: A build fixture with a featured image, covering the case where og:image dimensions must not be asserted.

title: Fixture: What a Market Report Is For
content:
This article does not exist. It is a build fixture, used only by a verification build that has no database, so the SEO checks can see a blog at all. See scripts/data/README.md.

This one has no featured image, so the page falls back to the site default — the branch where og:image:width and og:image:height ARE asserted, because that file's size is known. It also sits in a second registry category, so a verification build renders more than one /blog/category page.

Keeping it in the fixture means that path runs on every verification build rather than being something somebody once checked by hand and then stopped checking.

title: Fixture: An Unlisted Category
content:
This article does not exist. It is a build fixture, used only by a verification build that has no database, so the SEO checks can see a blog at all. See scripts/data/README.md.

Its category is not in src/config/blog-categories.ts, which is the case US-166 exists for: no /blog/category route is generated, the article still ships, and the prerender names the category. Before US-166 this shape failed the entire build with a message about missing titles.

Keeping it in the fixture means that path runs on every verification build rather than being something somebody once checked by hand and then stopped checking.
excerpt: A third build fixture, in a category the registry does not have, exercising the US-166 path.
category: Fixture Category That Is Not Registered
seo_description: A build fixture whose category is not in the registry, so no category page is generated for it.
